source.title: Editor: Create menu submenu heading is hardcoded English

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

The create menu in the sidebar shows a "Create in" heading at the top of each project submenu. This heading is hardcoded English. It is used for workflows, credentials, variables, data tables and agents.

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/58f11bf0cf5e384efa7f6818fc940ff5ed8200a9/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/app/composables/useGlobalEntityCreation.ts#L130
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/58f11bf0cf5e384efa7f6818fc940ff5ed8200a9/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/app/composables/useGlobalEntityCreation.ts#L168
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/58f11bf0cf5e384efa7f6818fc940ff5ed8200a9/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/app/composables/useGlobalEntityCreation.ts#L347
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/58f11bf0cf5e384efa7f6818fc940ff5ed8200a9/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/app/composables/useGlobalEntityCreation.ts#L381
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/58f11bf0cf5e384efa7f6818fc940ff5ed8200a9/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/app/composables/useGlobalEntityCreation.ts#L420

The other items in the same submenus use i18n, for example `projects.menu.personal` and `projects.menu.create.workflow`.

### To Reproduce

1. Use an instance with at least one team project.
2. Switch the instance UI to a language other than English.
3. Click the **+** button in the sidebar.
4. Hover **New workflow**. The submenu heading reads "Create in" in English.

### Expected behavior

The heading uses an i18n key and shows in the active language.

### Debug Info

Found by reading the source on `master` (version `2.45.0`). The strings are hardcoded in the source, so this does not depend on the instance setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.45.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a PR ready for this.
